purpose: Close reviewer-facing mechanism-ablation and adversarial-validation gaps without reopening frozen RQ2.

validator_layers.no_validation: A strictly parsed candidate crosses the execution boundary without semantic checks.
validator_layers.schema_type_only: IR parsing, graph, schema, type, and operator capability checks; policy is ignored.
validator_layers.policy_output_only: Schema/type and policy decision plus direct-output checks; no deterministic repair, all-path obligation proof, snapshot binding, or evidence closure.
validator_layers.trustaero_full: Complete deterministic validation, safe rewrite, and independent postcondition checks.

planner_design.governance_blind_baseline: frozen cost model ranks all observed candidates before checking policy feasibility
planner_design.legality_first_method: hard feasibility pruning followed by the same frozen cost model
planner_design.soft_penalty_excluded_reason: No finite penalty guarantees a hard governance constraint; an infinite penalty is equivalent to pruning.

certificate_design.method: replay registered rejected faults against enabled independent checker components

claim_limits: Offline replay is not a new independent holdout.
Mutation fuzz establishes zero observed unsafe acceptance only for the frozen mutation grammar and seed.
Certificate component replay measures registered-fault coverage, not cryptographic execution proof.
V3/V4 comparison reuses frozen separate runs and must not be described as a paired same-run benchmark.
